items.briefing:
Ransomware remains a serious concern for Australian and New Zealand organisations, with a new study finding many victims are still choosing to pay ransoms rather than recover independently — a trend that encourages further attacks. Globally, over 1,100 ransomware incidents were recorded in Q2 2026 alone, with industrial sectors among the hardest hit. Separately, a NSW government audit has found major agencies repeatedly failing the same cybersecurity controls, suggesting known problems are not being fixed.

If your organisation uses cloud services or AI tools, be aware that access permissions can be difficult to track and easy to overlook. **Practical tip:** Regularly review who has access to your organisation's cloud accounts and remove access for anyone who no longer needs it.

featured.title: Many ANZ ransomware victims still pay, study finds
featured.quote: Australian organisations paying ransoms still fail to recover data, exposing critical business continuity risks.
